hook: Human DNA found in Olney house linked to seven missing women

sections.voiceover: Human DNA found in Olney house linked to seven missing women, CBS Philadelphia reported on October 14, 2026, citing police sources.
Investigators used luminol to search the Olney house for evidence. Human DNA was found in several places inside the house, including the kitchen and bedrooms.
This discovery shakes the community and raises serious concerns about the investigation.
Human DNA was found in 1 of the 7 places searched, leading to a potential breakthrough in the missing women case.
Keep an eye on the investigation for more updates.
